notes.title: Wishlist LOVE, our next game!
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing Word Forward! We're pleased to share with you, our friends in letterati, details of our next puzzling plaything. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239490/LOVE__A_Puzzle_Box_Filled_with_Stories/][i]LOVE - A Puzzle Box Filled with Stories[/i][/url] is an experiment in storytelling that combines the rich experience of a diorama with puzzles inspired by point-and-click adventures. LOVE creates opportunities for empathy and reflection, as well as moments of classic head-scratching puzzle goodness.

It's coming later this year. If you want to know more, be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239490/LOVE__A_Puzzle_Box_Filled_with_Stories/]wishlist [i]LOVE [/i]on our Steam page[/url] to stay in the loop!
